notes: INSIDE half of the Prismatic Glimmer Turret: a single tall crystal on a violet pedestal with two small light-guides, a steel hatch, power coupling and five crystals. damaged: the crystal cracked and dark; disabled: split and dull. The rotating head prismatic_glimmer_turret_barrel swivels in the ring: a violet ring head carrying a floating faceted crystal that points where it aims, two orbiting shards and a sensor crystal; fire: the crystal flares and a bright shard darts out.
